description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy values for a model across several conditions. The horizontal axis displays the experimental condition, labeled “s text”, “w/o select”, “w/o emotion”, “w/o cognition”, and “Ours”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage (%), with a linear scale ranging from 75.0 to 91.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. Five bars are present, each representing a different condition; these bars are colored red, light blue, dark blue, teal, and maroon. The “s text” bar is maroon and extends to approximately 88.80%, while the “w/o select” bar is light blue and reaches approximately 80.10%. The “w/o emotion” bar is dark blue and extends to approximately 87.17%, the “w/o cognition” bar is teal and reaches approximately 83.02%, and the “Ours” bar is red and extends to approximately 90.57%. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are not sorted in any apparent order beyond alphabetical arrangement of the condition labels.
